newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Banesto soars on favourable outlook.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Banesto soars on favourable outlook.

text.p: Shares in Spain's Banco Espanol de Credito (Banesto) were strongly higher on Monday, supported by favourable prospects based on the bank's fundamentals, dealers said.
At 1145 GMT, Banesto was up 50 pesetas, 4.05 percent, to 1,285 pesetas while the Ibex-35 blue chip index was up 0.06 percent to 5,736.01.
Financial daily Expansion reported today that Banesto was considering the possibility of paying a 315 billion pesetas loan from the Deposit Guarantee Fund earlier than expected.
A Banesto spokesman told Reuters that an early payment "is a possibility that the chairman has commented on several times," but added that as yet no decision had been made.
Traders said the shares were gaining on the basis of the report, which indicated that the bank's prospects were good.
"Banesto's seen a strong rise as it nears the end of its restructuring, and obviously if it can pay this debt earlier than expected it's doing well," said a dealer at a Spanish bank.
Since April 11, Banesto shares have risen 20 percent.
The bank posted a 16.8 percent rise in first quarter earnings to 8.16 billion pesetas on April 14.
